name: Server Properties
description: Edit every server.properties key with the right editor (text, number, true/false, options, password) through saved instance-page actions. Stateful React page: auto-detects server.properties, mc/server.properties or /mc/server.properties, single flat card with all keys, global Apply/Cancel action pill (no per-row buttons, no category sections). Restart required.
bundle_css: .ks-react-page input, .ks-react-page select, .ks-react-page textarea { background: var(--ks-input-bg, rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) !important; border: 1px solid var(--ks-input-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.15)) !important; color: var(--ks-input-text, var(--ks-body, #e5e7eb)) !important; color-scheme: dark; }.ks-react-page select option { background: #1f2937 !important; color: #e5e7eb !important; }.ks-react-page input::placeholder, .ks-react-page textarea::placeholder { color: var(--ks-input-placeholder, #6b7280) !important; opacity: 1; }.ks-react-page input:disabled, .ks-react-page select:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }
actions: [{"description":"Read server.properties in the instance root.","name":"read_props","path":"server.properties","type":"read_file"},{"description":"Read mc/server.properties as a fallback location.","name":"read_props_mc","path":"mc/server.properties","type":"read_file"},{"description":"Read /mc/server.properties as a fallback location.","name":"read_props_abs","path":"/mc/server.properties","type":"read_file"},{"command":"set -- {{args}}; F=\"$1\"; KV=\"$2\"; K=\"${KV%%=*}\"; V=\"${KV#*=}\"; [ -n \"$F\" ] && [ -n \"$K\" ] && [ \"$KV\" != \"$K\" ] && touch \"$F\" && awk -v k=\"$K\" -v v=\"$V\" 'BEGIN{d=0} /^\\r?$|^[ \\t]*#/ {print;next} {p=index($0,\"=\"); if(p>0){kk=substr($0,1,p-1); gsub(/^[ \\t]+|[ \\t]+$/, \"\", kk); if(kk==k){print k\"=\"v; d=1; next}}} {print} END{if(!d) print k\"=\"v}' \"$F\" > \"$F.tmp\" && mv \"$F.tmp\" \"$F\" && echo \"saved $K\"","description":"Set one server.properties key: runtime args are [file, key=value]. Preserves comments/order, appends missing keys.","name":"set_prop","open_args":true,"timeout":30,"type":"shell"},{"command":"set -- {{args}}; A=${1##*/}; [ -n \"$A\" ] && mkdir -p backups && for F in server.properties mc/server.properties /mc/server.properties; do if [ -f \"$F\" ]; then cp \"$F\" \"backups/$A\" && echo \"saved-backups/$A-from-$F\"; break; fi; done","description":"Copy the active server.properties into backups/<name> (runtime filename, basename-jailed).","name":"backup_props","open_args":true,"timeout":30,"type":"shell"}]
